parties:
Abul Kashem Shikder @ Kashem Ali Shikder ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Fazlul Haque Shikder and ors ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 9. Mr. M.A. Wahhab Mia, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the defendant-petitioner No. 1 submits that, the plaintiff has not been able to prove his case that the property was taken settlement in their joint names and he shared the money and that he possessed the suit land adversely to the defendant-petitioner. Mr. Wahhab further argued that the plaintiff firstly claimed title and possession of the suit land on the basis of taking joint settlement but when he failed, he took the plea of adverse possession in the suit land but again failed to prove the same. This is further argued that the lower appellate court has erred in law in reading the plaint in a different way and giving a different meaning substituting his own language and as such, the impugned judgment is not maintainable in law etc. This is further argued by him that the learned Subordinate Judge has failed to find that out of the suit plots the defendant gifted 4 decimals of land to local primary school in exercise of his possession as owner of the same and the plaintiff did not oppose the same but admitted, which is also a proof of exercise of exclusive right and possession of the suit land by the defendant-petitioner. This has been further argued that the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal and the same is totally perversed both in facts and law. On the other hand the finding of the learned Senior Assistant Judge were based on pleadings and evidence of the parties.
